title: Run catalog discovery and selection in command recipes
changes: Allow bounded content and cheat discovery, content selection by ID, and catalog queries in typed recipes, waiting for each existing terminal result before the next action.
Preserve ledger-protected request identities for selection and refresh; stop on failures and leave ambiguous read queries unconfirmed rather than retrying them.
validation: Windows GNU runtime and test build passed; 29 focused Wine tests covered catalog ordering, selection refusal, lost-response recovery with the same identity, ambiguous-read refusal and existing recipe contracts.

In an isolated EUR Wine/Xvfb interpreter session, content refresh and a four-entry list completed in order; an invalid selection prevented the next step, explicit resume remained stopped, and guest state and protected inputs were unchanged. The GUI closed normally.
The first real-session wrapper incorrectly expected a limit field absent from the result and was corrected to check returned entries and generation; failed diagnostics were retained.
limitations: Successful selection and cheat catalog operations have synthetic rather than real-session recipe coverage. Other action types, interactive picker, pending-mutating-action crash and native Windows remain open; the real-session unit retains private inputs as a named current proof.
